purpose: Resolve the directly supported portion of the post-V6 23-field residue without reopening a generic promotion queue.

evidence_sources.note: CORE_FIELDS explicitly labels attemptsIbox as Shots inside box and attemptsObox as Shots outside box under the direct team-match governed field boundary.
Provides direct descriptions for attFreekickPost, attIboxOwnGoal, attLgCentre/Left/Right, attemptsIbox/Obox and points gained/dropped fields.
Used only to confirm continued use of the directly defined field families; it is not used to manufacture semantics for unresolved fields.

fields.attFreekickPost: Direct free kick that hits the post/woodwork.
fields.attIboxOwnGoal: Own goal from inside the box.
fields.attLgCentre: Shot from central area outside the box at long range (>35 yards).
fields.attLgLeft: Shot from left outside the box at long range (>35 yards).
fields.attLgRight: Shot from right outside the box at long range (>35 yards).
fields.attemptsIbox: Total shots from inside the box; independently labelled as Shots inside box in FRL's governed match_stats boundary.
fields.attemptsObox: Total shots from outside the box; independently labelled as Shots outside box in FRL's governed match_stats boundary.

explicit_non_promotion.winningGoal: Compatible providers use winning_goal as a game-winning-goal indicator, but no direct enough definition for this PulseLive team-match representation has been established.

governance_note: These fields are promoted as source-native team-match concepts only. No new structural-zero rule, cross-provider equality or derived-rate approval is created.
